title: Pyne Pod Summer Punch Nic Salts 10ml E-Liquid
description: Pyne Pod NicSalts Summer Punch 10ml E-Liquid is an unapologetically bright and complex blend designed for lovers of bold fruit profiles. This lively recipe features a dynamic mix of exotic fruits, weaving together layers of sweet, tangy, and juicy tropical notes. With no single fruit overpowering the others, it provides a highly varied and robust flavour journey from the first inhale to the satisfying, mouth-watering finish. Available in 5mg, 10mg, and 20mg nicotine strengths, this premium nicotine salt formulation ensures rapid delivery and a smooth, comfortable throat sensation to effectively manage nicotine intake. The balanced 50VG/50PG ratio provides an ideal combination of clear, intense flavour and discreet vapour production. Pyne Pod Nic Salts are designed specifically to perform reliably with low-wattage mouth-to-lung hardware, including refillable pod vape kits and classic starter vape kits. The Pyne Pod Nic Salts collection translates the intense, highly popular flavours of their renowned prefilled pods into a versatile 10ml format. Offering a more cost-effective and flexible alternative, the range covers a wide variety of tastes. Beyond the tropical explosion of Summer Punch, vapers can explore other irresistible blends such as the deep complexity of Mr Blue, the crisp chill of Pomegranate Ice, or the sophisticated Pink Purple Lemonade.
